# Commands

## Debugging

### `:DebuggerStatus`

Show which languages have a debugger configured and whether its adapter binary is installed

```vim
:DebuggerStatus
```

## Diagnostics

### `:LinterStatus`

Show which linter(s) are configured/available for the current buffer, and all linters by filetype

```vim
:LinterStatus
```

### `:NvimConfigHealth`

Run the structured health report for this config (alias for :checkhealth nvim-config)

```vim
:NvimConfigHealth
```

## Documentation

### `:NvimCommands`

List every command this config defines, grouped by category

```vim
:NvimCommands
```

### `:NvimDocs`

Open local documentation: built Sphinx HTML if available, else :help nvim-config

```vim
:NvimDocs
```

### `:NvimKeymaps`

List every keymap this config defines, grouped by group

```vim
:NvimKeymaps
```

## Formatting

### `:Format`

Format the current buffer

```vim
:Format
```

### `:FormatDisable`

Disable format-on-save globally

```vim
:FormatDisable
```

### `:FormatEnable`

Enable format-on-save globally

```vim
:FormatEnable
```

### `:FormatStatus`

Show whether format-on-save is currently active for this buffer, and why

```vim
:FormatStatus
```

### `:FormatToggle`

Toggle format-on-save (buffer-local; add ! for global)

```vim
:FormatToggle!
```

### `:FormatterStatus`

Show which formatter(s) are configured/available for the current buffer, and all formatters by filetype

```vim
:FormatterStatus
```

## Git

### `:Git [git-subcommand]`

Run any git command through vim-fugitive; bare :Git opens the interactive status buffer

```vim
:Git blame
```

### `:Gitsigns`

Gitsigns subcommands (staging, blame, hunks)

```vim
:Gitsigns preview_hunk
```

### `:Gvdiffsplit`

Open a vertical three-way diff of the current file against the index (fugitive)

```vim
:Gvdiffsplit
```

## LSP

### `:LspStatus`

Show configured LSP servers (installed) and clients attached to the current buffer

```vim
:LspStatus
```

## Plugins

### `:NvimTreeFindFile`

Open nvim-tree and reveal the current buffer's file

```vim
:NvimTreeFindFile
```

### `:NvimTreeToggle`

Toggle the nvim-tree sidebar

```vim
:NvimTreeToggle
```

### `:Oil`

Open Oil file explorer

```vim
:Oil
```

### `:TSInstall <language>`

Install a Tree-sitter parser (network; explicit action only)

```vim
:TSInstall rust
```

### `:TSUpdate`

Update installed Tree-sitter parsers (network; explicit action only)

```vim
:TSUpdate
```

### `:Telescope <picker>`

Open a Telescope picker by name

```vim
:Telescope find_files
```

### `:Trouble`

Open Trouble (diagnostics/quickfix/loclist list)

```vim
:Trouble diagnostics toggle
```

## Python

### `:Pytest [file|nearest|all|last] [pytest args...]`

Run pytest in a terminal split with the project's interpreter (.venv aware): file, nearest, all, or last

```vim
:Pytest nearest -x
```

### `:PythonInfo`

Show the Python interpreter/venv in use, the type checker choice and the attached servers

```vim
:PythonInfo
```

### `:PythonLsp [ty|basedpyright|both]`

Choose the Python type checker for this session: ty (default), basedpyright or both; no arg shows the current choice

```vim
:PythonLsp basedpyright
```

## Terminal

### `:TermToggle`

Toggle the persistent terminal split at the bottom of the screen

```vim
:TermToggle
```

## Tools

### `:LangInfo [language|pack|all ...]`

Show tools (installed or missing), parsers and attached servers for a language, alias, pack, or 'all' (no arg: current buffer)

```vim
:LangInfo rust
```

### `:LangInstall [language|pack|all ...]`

Install language server(s), formatter, linter, debugger and Tree-sitter parsers via Mason for one or more languages, aliases (ts, js, py, rs, ...), packs (web, systems, jvm, ...), or 'all' (no arg: current buffer's language; --lsp: LSP + parsers only; !: include inactive alternatives; network)

```vim
:LangInstall web
```

### `:LangInstallLsp [language|pack|all ...]`

Install only the LSP server(s) and Tree-sitter parsers for one or more languages, aliases, packs (web, systems, ...), or 'all' (network)

```vim
:LangInstallLsp all
```

### `:LangPacks`

List all language packs (web, systems, jvm, ...), their member languages, and short aliases (ts, js, py, ...)

```vim
:LangPacks
```

### `:Mason`

Open the Mason installer UI

```vim
:Mason
```

### `:MasonInstall <package>...`

Install a specific Mason package (network; explicit action only)

```vim
:MasonInstall rust-analyzer
```

### `:MasonUpdate`

Refresh the Mason registry (network; explicit action only)

```vim
:MasonUpdate
```

### `:ToolsInstall <profile>`

Install every Mason-installable tool for a profile (core, systems, python, web, jvm, dotnet, functional, devops, docs, scripting, all)

```vim
:ToolsInstall systems
```

### `:ToolsStatus`

Show installed/missing status for every LSP/formatter/linter/debugger this config knows about

```vim
:ToolsStatus
```

### `:ToolsUpdate <profile>`

Update every Mason-installed tool for a profile (or 'all')

```vim
:ToolsUpdate all
```

## UI

### `:MarkdownRender [on|off]`

Toggle in-editor markdown rendering (render-markdown.nvim); 'on'/'off' to set explicitly

```vim
:MarkdownRender on
```

### `:RelativeNumbersToggle`

Toggle relative/absolute line numbers in the current window

```vim
:RelativeNumbersToggle
```
